affine_hull.full_jet_simulation: At x=xc+Uz, one original full jet supplies D^j Ftilde(z)[v1,...,vj]=U^T D^j F(x)[Uv1,...,Uvj] for j>=1 and Ftilde(z)=U^T F(x). Retain the full original F(x) at the final certified point.
affine_hull.normal_lift: For ntilde in N_K(z), return x=xc+Uz and n=U ntilde-(I-UU^T)F(x). Then n in N_X(x), F(x)+n=U(Ftilde(z)+ntilde), and ||F(x)+n||=||Ftilde(z)+ntilde||. The saved final full F(x) supplies the evaluated original certificate without an additional query.
affine_hull.public_reduction: For known aff(X)=xc+U R^r with U^T U=I_r, set K={z:xc+Uz in X}, z0=U^T(x0-xc), and Ftilde(z)=U^T F(xc+Uz). K has the same diameter and the solution distance is preserved. Monotonicity and the highest-derivative Lipschitz bound are preserved or improved.
affine_hull.singleton: When r=0, X is its unique known point xc. Query F(xc) once if an evaluated certificate is required, set n=-F(xc), and return the zero-residual certificate. A point-only output needs no query; the evaluated-certificate case uses at most one.

content.family: Finite hierarchy of strong and residual certified solver interfaces

hierarchy.construction: For j=1,...,p-1 instantiate Aj=ExtrapolatedHalpern(S_{j-1}). For j<p-1 only, instantiate Sj=AdaptiveStrong(RestartTrial(Aj)), using the published wrappers. Each callable receives the already established lower-level constants and interruptible caps. No S_{p-1} is needed or instantiated.
hierarchy.exponents: gamma_j=gamma_{j-1}/(1+gamma_{j-1})=2/(p+1+2j), bA_j=6j, and bS_j=6j+2 for instantiated strong levels j<p-1. At boost j, a_j=(p-1)gamma_{j-1}=2(p-1)/(p+2j-1)<=2 and 3a_j/2=3(p-1)/(p+2j-1)>=1. Equality in the latter holds at j=p-1. Final gamma_{p-1}=2/(3p-1), bA_{p-1}=6(p-1).
hierarchy.initialization: Instantiate S0=AdaptiveStrong(BaseTrial), using alg.arxiv2609_13462.adaptive_strong revision 1 and alg.arxiv2609_13462.base_trial revision 1. BaseTrial uses the published Halve routine. Proposition 5.2 gives gamma0=2/(p+1), bS0=2.
hierarchy.resource_accounting: Depth depends only on fixed p. Every nested regularization adds known affine data, so a jet of any nested operator uses one original-F jet. Every active ancestor cap is charged before each original query, including failed radius trials and final certificate evaluations. Known leading constants are attached recursively in construction order. No unknown optimal solver is invoked inside itself.

limitations.statement: Exact known-model and domain computations have no asserted polynomial runtime or bit-complexity guarantee.
The supplied-distance upper guarantee does not establish a matching joint dependence on independently prescribed R and D.

model.domain_and_norm: Finite-dimensional Euclidean space; known nonempty compact convex X with diam(X)<=D and x0 in X. Derivative tensors use the induced multilinear operator norm. N_X(x)={n:<n,u-x><=0 for all u in X}.
model.information: Public X,d,p,Lp,D,x0,epsilon and, for the distance variant, R. Unknown F is accessed only through exact feasible full jets (F,DF,...,D^(p-1)F). Solutions and actual distances remain hidden. Exact projection and solving known Taylor-model VIs are internal operations, not a free unknown-F resolvent.
model.regularity: Fixed integer p>=2; Lp,D,epsilon>0; F is monotone on X, C^(p-1) on a neighborhood and Lip(D^(p-1)F)<=Lp. No positive original strong-monotonicity modulus or separate lower-derivative bound is required.
